scenarios.title: A｜主动询问
scenarios.setting: 一个原本经常联系的朋友最近突然变得冷淡，玩家决定询问。

turns.prompt: 你想关心朋友最近的疏远是否与自己有关，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, is everything okay between us?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, is everything okay between us?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Maybe I’m imagining it, but you seem a little distant lately.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe I’m imagining it, but you seem a little distant lately.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I feel like we haven’t talked much recently. Is something going on?

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel like we haven’t talked much recently. Is something going on?
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: I wanted to check in because things have felt a little different between us lately.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to check in because things have felt a little different between us lately.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: Why are you avoiding me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, is everything okay between us?
feedback.explanation: “avoiding me”认定对方刻意躲避；先说最近联系少了，再问是否有事，更容易得到回应。

turns.prompt: 你想解释为什么注意到朋友的近况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I just noticed you’ve been quieter than usual.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I just noticed you’ve been quieter than usual.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Maybe I’m reading too much into it. I just wanted to check.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe I’m reading too much into it. I just wanted to check.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I wasn’t trying to accuse you of anything. I just wanted to make sure we’re okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t trying to accuse you of anything. I just wanted to make sure we’re okay.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: You’ve turned down a few plans lately, so I wondered if something was wrong.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’ve turned down a few plans lately, so I wondered if something was wrong.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

turns.text: I’ve just had a lot going on recently.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I understand. I just wanted to make sure.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I understand. I just wanted to make sure.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: That’s fair. I’m here if you want to talk.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. I’m here if you want to talk.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

scenarios.title: B｜对方说没事
scenarios.setting: 在“朋友突然疏远”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方说没事”。

turns.text: Yeah. Everything’s fine. I’ve just been busy.

turns.prompt: 你想表示尊重朋友暂时不想倾诉的意愿，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I don’t want to pressure you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I don’t want to pressure you.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: All right. I just wanted to check in.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I just wanted to check in.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Okay. If something is bothering you, you can always tell me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. If something is bothering you, you can always tell me.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: I believe you. Just know I’m here if you need anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: I believe you. Just know I’m here if you need anything.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: No, I know something is wrong. Tell me.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I don’t want to pressure you.
feedback.explanation: “I know … Tell me”可能让对方觉得被逼问；表示愿意听，同时允许对方暂时不说，更尊重其节奏。

turns.text: Thanks. I just need a little time to myself right now.

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友突然疏远」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. I’ll give you some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. I’ll give you some space.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That’s totally fine. Take the time you need.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s totally fine. Take the time you need.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I understand. You can reach out whenever you feel like it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. You can reach out whenever you feel like it.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Okay. I won’t keep bothering you, but I’m here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I won’t keep bothering you, but I’m here.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Anytime. Take care of yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: Anytime. Take care of yourself.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

choices.text: Of course. Talk whenever you’re ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Talk whenever you’re ready.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

scenarios.title: C｜对方坦白原因
scenarios.setting: 在“朋友突然疏远”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方坦白原因”。

turns.prompt: 你想表示愿意听朋友讲述，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’m listening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’m listening.
feedback.explanation: “I’m listening”表明愿意听下去，把接下来的表达空间留给对方。

choices.text: You can tell me.

feedback.naturalExpression: You can tell me.
feedback.explanation: “You can tell me”表达愿意倾听，让对方决定要不要继续说。

choices.text: All right. What’s been bothering you?

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. What’s been bothering you?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: I’d rather know than keep guessing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather know than keep guessing.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: When everyone went out last weekend, I felt like you basically ignored me the whole night.

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry. I honestly didn’t realize you felt that way.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry. I honestly didn’t realize you felt that way.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: I can understand why that would’ve hurt.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can understand why that would’ve hurt.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I wasn’t intentionally ignoring you, but I can see how it looked that way.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t intentionally ignoring you, but I can see how it looked that way.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I wish you’d told me sooner, but I’m glad you’re telling me now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wish you’d told me sooner, but I’m glad you’re telling me now.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

turns.text: I know it probably wasn’t intentional. I just felt really left out.

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fair. I’m sorry I made you feel excluded.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. I’m sorry I made you feel excluded.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: I should’ve made more of an effort to include you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I should’ve made more of an effort to include you.
feedback.explanation: “should’ve”谈过去时可表示本该这样做，适合反思或承认疏忽。

choices.text: Thanks for being honest with me. I’ll be more aware of it next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for being honest with me. I’ll be more aware of it next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I don’t want you to feel like you don’t matter to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want you to feel like you don’t matter to me.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: Thanks. That’s really all I wanted you to understand.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的坦白，肯定这次沟通，会怎么说？

choices.text: I do. And I’m glad we talked about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I do. And I’m glad we talked about it.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Me too. I’d rather you tell me when something’s bothering you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Me too. I’d rather you tell me when something’s bothering you.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。
